content:
Goal: Create a cute Japanese “animal character donut diagnosis” infographic poster for {argument name="diagnosis animal" default="wolf"}, in a pastel kawaii dessert style, as if generated from text only.

Canvas: Vertical 2:3 poster, soft pink bakery/café background with pearls, lace, sparkles, tiny hearts, stars, flowers, ribbons, and glossy confectionery decorations. Use a warm cream-and-pink palette with lavender, sky blue, mint, and gold accents. Everything should feel magical, sweet, and highly decorative.

Main headline area: At the top, large rounded bubble-letter Japanese title text reading 「どうぶつキャラドーナツ診断」 in pink with white outline and drop shadow. Under it, smaller text 「あなたには」, then very large golden-orange outlined text 「オオカミ」, followed by 「の気配が漂っています」. Add tiny paw prints, stars, flower stickers, and pastel ribbon ornaments around the title.

Right-side main visual: Place a circular ornate gold-framed portrait on the upper right, decorated with small cream flowers and pink ribbons. Inside the frame is a stylish handsome anime man, shown from chest up, wearing a dark suit, white shirt, and tie, with dramatic wavy black hair illuminated by neon magenta and electric blue highlights against a dark starry background. Cover the center of his face with a vertical soft-edged rectangular blur block in muted mauve, as if anonymized.

Bottom-right dessert subject: In front of the portrait, place one large realistic-cute animal donut on a decorative plate. The donut is shaped like a gray wolf/cat face: round purple-gray icing, two pointed ears, glossy black eyes, small pink cheeks, white muzzle, tiny black nose and smiling mouth, white icing whisker lines, and a fluffy tail-like crescent piece on the lower right. Decorate the donut with exactly 3 clusters of blueberry-like dark blue berries and tiny purple sugar flowers, plus pearl sprinkles and white icing drizzles. Add a small round cookie tag on the plate reading “You are Special.”

Left column: Create exactly 5 stacked rounded information cards, each with a translucent glossy border, pastel gradient fill, small icon, and Japanese text. The five cards are:
1. Pink card with donut icon, heading 「理由は」, body text 「鋭さとやさしさが同居する雰囲気、静かだけど芯が強くて少し近寄りがたい存在感が強いからです(｡•ᴗ•｡)」.
2. Purple card with crescent moon icon, heading 「オオカミの特徴」, exactly 4 bullet points: 「判断が早い」, 「仲間思い」, 「ミステリアス」, 「一度決めたらぶれにくい」.
3. Light blue card with sun icon, heading 「相性が良い動物」, exactly 2 illustrated animal icons and 2 bullet items: fox icon with 「キツネ：機転がきいて会話のテンポが合う」, cat icon with 「ネコ：距離感が心地よく、自然体でいられる」.
4. Mint green card with clover icon, heading 「運勢」, body text 「今は魅力が静かに伝わる好調期。信頼が積み上がり、じわじわ注目が集まります(≧▽≦)」.
5. Pink card with donut icon and blueberry icon, heading 「オオカミドーナツについて」, body text 「ビターなコーティングにホワイトチョコのライン、ブルーベリーのきらめきで凛とした甘さを表現。香ばしい生地と上品な仕上げで食べやすく、特別感のある一品です(๑•᎑•๑)」.

Visual style: Hyper-detailed kawaii Japanese social-media diagnostic card, glossy stickers, soft glow, pastel gradients, rounded typography, edible 3D donut realism mixed with anime illustration. Keep the composition dense but readable, with the left cards aligned neatly and the portrait/donut dominating the right side.

Constraints: Use exactly 5 information cards, exactly 4 bullets in the traits card, exactly 2 animals in the compatibility card, and one main animal donut. Preserve the Japanese text exactly as written. No extra logos or watermarks.

Create a square 1:1 high-energy kawaii superhero comic poster with a glittery rose-gold sequin background and a thin pale pink rectangular border. In the center, place a chibi superhero child/mascot body in a shiny blue armored suit with red gloves, one fist raised in a punch pose, dark brown hair in a big swept-up bun, and a plain centered square face placeholder covering the face in medium brown. Surround the hero with exactly three cute fluffy kittens in dynamic flying poses: one large white-and-brown kitten on the lower left with big sparkling eyes and open smiling mouth, one cream ragdoll-style kitten on the upper right leaping forward with fluffy tail, and one small brown tabby-and-white kitten on the lower right smiling near yellow comic exclamation marks. Add comic-book action graphics: a yellow burst on the upper left with the word “KAPOW” in bold pink letters, multiple yellow stars, black speed lines, colorful confetti rectangles, sparkles, and pop-art outlines. At the bottom, add huge bubbly title text reading {argument name="title text" default="Super Kawaii Three Kittens"}, using hot pink fill, dark navy shadow, white outline, and a cyan outer glow, stacked across two lines. Overall style should be glossy Japanese kawaii, chibi superhero, sticker-like thick black outlines, vibrant saturated colors, cute expressive animal faces, celebratory sparkle effects, and crisp digital illustration suitable for a social media announcement graphic. Keep the count to exactly three kittens, exactly one central superhero figure, and one visible “KAPOW” burst; do not add extra characters or text.

Goal: Create a dramatic cinematic fighting-game character poster for {argument name="character name" default="Blue Mary"}, inspired by a dark cyberpunk arcade character-select splash screen.

Canvas: Wide 16:9 horizontal banner, high-detail semi-realistic anime/game key art, dark navy and black palette with electric blue highlights, gritty particles, glass shards, rain-like specks, and strong rim lighting.

Layout: Split the composition into 3 major visual zones: left seated character pose, center title typography, and right action character pose. Add thin futuristic HUD interface graphics around the edges.

Subject details: Show exactly 2 full/partial depictions of the same athletic blonde female fighter. Depiction 1 on the left: she lounges on a rough wooden bench in a shadowy industrial room beside tall window panes, leaning back casually with one knee raised, wearing a red halter crop top, loose blue pants with a white star-in-circle emblem on the thigh, brown belt, black fingerless gloves, brown boots, and an olive-green jacket slipping off her shoulders. Depiction 2 on the right: she stands in a dynamic forward-punch fighting pose, torso angled toward camera, one gloved fist thrust toward the viewer, wearing the same red halter crop top, loose blue pants, brown belt, and black fingerless gloves, with short blonde bob hair lit by blue rim light. Faces may be covered by soft rectangular blur blocks if a censored/anonymous look is desired.

Central typography: Place a huge distressed title reading {argument name="main title text" default="BLUE MARY"} in the middle, with “BLUE” in bright electric blue above “MARY” in weathered white. Under it, add the quote {argument name="subtitle quote" default="フッ…… Let's fight!"} in white italic serif/script styling with a thin blue underline.

HUD and text elements: Include exactly 6 visible interface text clusters: 1) top-left cluster with “BLUE MARY”, small bars, “CODE: BM-01”, “TARGET: YOU”, “STATUS: LOCKED ON”, “SYSTEM: OVERWRITE”, and “> READY TO FIGHT”; 2) mid-left ID block with boxed “BM” and “BLUE MARY”; 3) bottom-left small “EST. 1994” plus barcode; 4) top-right cluster with “BLUE MARY”, a globe icon, “I WON'T LOSE.” and “NOT TO ANYONE.”; 5) right-edge vertical label “BM-01”; 6) bottom-right cluster with “TARGET: YOU”, “STATUS: LOCKED ON”, plus minimal crosshair/slider marks.

Visual style: High-contrast glossy digital painting, realistic fabric and skin shading, sharp muscular anatomy, dramatic blue explosion and shattered-glass burst behind the right figure, moody warehouse lighting on the left, polished fighting game promotional art, intense cinematic depth and motion.

Constraints: Use exactly 2 character depictions, exactly 6 HUD text clusters, no extra characters, no watermark, keep all typography legible, preserve the dark blue combat-interface atmosphere.

Create a highly detailed, polished anime fantasy illustration of a serene underwater angel girl resting against an ancient curved stone structure. The scene shows one young female angel with {argument name="hair color" default="long flowing golden-blonde hair"}, soft amber eyes, delicate pale skin, and a calm melancholic expression, wearing a translucent layered {argument name="dress style" default="white lace dress with ruffled organza and floral details"}. She has exactly two large white feathered wings spread behind her, illuminated by sunlight from the water surface above. Her body floats diagonally from lower left to upper right, bare legs extended, one arm gently hugging the mossy stone arch. The setting is a luminous deep-blue underwater ruin with clear water, bubbles, caustic light rays, drifting fabric, and small marine growth. Include exactly one large curved ancient stone arch or boat-like ruin covered in dark teal moss, coral, tiny white flowers, and ornate spiral carvings. Add many floating white feathers of different sizes around her, with three prominent blurred foreground feathers near the lower right and right edge, plus smaller sharp feathers near the wings. The composition should be vertical, cinematic, and immersive, with the bright sunburst centered near the top, rippling water surface overhead, intense turquoise-to-cobalt blue background, and soft volumetric god rays. Use intricate feather rendering, realistic underwater lighting, sparkling highlights, clean detail retention, no noise, no ink splatter, no text, no watermark, no frame. Style: premium Japanese anime key visual, ethereal fantasy, painterly but crisp, delicate facial features, highly refined fabric transparency, romantic and dreamlike atmosphere. Use {argument name="aspect ratio" default="3:4 vertical"}.

Create a bright, highly detailed anime illustration of {argument name="character description" default="twin young girls with pale silver-white bobbed hair"} walking side by side on a sunny resort pathway in Tomamu, Hokkaido. Both characters have their faces intentionally covered by smooth pale gray square blocks with no facial features. They wear matching airy white layered dresses with pale blue-gray ribbons, oversized light cardigans, delicate bead chains, pom-pom charms, small crossbody bags, white socks, and chunky white sneakers. Count exactly two girls: the left twin points outward with her left hand and has a feathery bird-like wing accessory and fluffy pom-pom bag at her side; the right twin holds one hand near her collar and carries a small iridescent transparent shoulder bag. Add exactly two fluffy white long-tailed-tit bird hair ornaments, one perched beside each twin’s head, with tiny black eyes and soft black-and-white feather markings. Surround them with exactly nine visible translucent soap bubbles with rainbow iridescence, distributed across foreground, midground, and sky. The background is a realistic anime resort landscape: a paved garden walkway, vivid green lawns, shrubs, white-barked trees, mountain slopes, blue sky with soft clouds, a chalet-style building and patio umbrellas on the right, exactly two tall greenish condominium towers in the left background, and one dark rectangular high-rise tower in the right background. On the left foreground place a black resort sign reading {argument name="sign text" default="TOMAMU HOKKAIDO 星野リゾート"}. Use soft summer daylight, sparkling highlights, pastel blue-white color grading, delicate linework, dreamy iridescent effects, shallow depth of field, and a polished Japanese AI-art aesthetic. Overall mood: {argument name="mood" default="whimsical, fresh, luxurious resort fantasy"}.

Create a high-fashion Met Gala 2026 red-carpet editorial photograph of {argument name="character name" default="an elegant young woman"} posing on a grand blue carpeted staircase, viewed from behind in a graceful three-quarter turn with one hand resting at her waist and her head turned slightly over her shoulder. She has {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} hair styled in a polished romantic updo, a slender pale figure, bare shoulders, and a deliberately soft, indistinct face so the focus stays on the couture. Dress her in exactly 4 main outfit pieces: a strapless silver crystal-embroidered bodice, a long ivory satin center panel trailing down the back, a dramatic deep midnight navy velvet overskirt with voluminous gathered hip draping, and an extended floor-sweeping train covered with ornate silver floral embroidery and beadwork. The gown should feel opulent, sculptural, and museum-worthy, with glittering lace appliqué, botanical motifs, and heavy satin-velvet texture. Set the scene at {argument name="event setting" default="the Met Gala staircase"}, with dark teal-blue stairs decorated with small daisy-like flower motifs, dense cream-and-green floral walls on both sides, and a crowd of photographers in black tuxedos behind the subject holding cameras with bright flashes. Use a realistic celebrity paparazzi photo style, shallow depth of field, cinematic flash lighting, natural skin tones, crisp fabric detail, luxurious contrast, vertical 2:3 composition, and the atmosphere of a glamorous fashion gala. Avoid text, logos, watermarks, extra people in the foreground, distorted anatomy, and cartoon styling.

Create a full-body vertical editorial fashion photograph of {argument name="character name" default="a glamorous anime-inspired woman"} posing on the Met Gala staircase, centered and slightly turned with one hand gathering the skirt. She has {argument name="hair color" default="vivid purple"} hair styled in a high braided crown updo, elegant earrings, and a confident red-carpet posture; keep the face softly anonymized with a smooth skin-toned blur and no visible facial features. The setting is a crowded luxury gala entrance with dark-suited photographers in the background, bright camera flashes, cream-and-blue carpeted stairs with small star motifs, and dense cream flower hedges along the staircase. The outfit has exactly 6 main visible components: 1) a sculpted ivory corset bodice with sweetheart neckline, 2) a draped ivory satin skirt with long gathered train, 3) a deep midnight-navy velvet overskirt panel, 4) a long midnight-navy velvet open coat/cape with sweeping train, 5) ornate silver crystal floral embroidery and beaded appliqué cascading over the bodice, hips, sleeves, and hem, and 6) a black choker with a small pendant. Use {argument name="gown color palette" default="ivory satin, midnight navy velvet, silver crystal embellishments"}, ultra-luxury couture detailing, realistic fabric texture, cinematic flash photography, shallow depth of field, high contrast, glossy magazine quality, 3:4 vertical composition, no logos, no text, no watermark.

Create a glamorous vertical high-fashion red-carpet photograph at the Met Gala, featuring exactly three elegant anime-inspired female celebrities posing on wide midnight-blue stairs in front of a crowded paparazzi background. The scene is cinematic, ultra-detailed, realistic, and editorial, with bright camera flashes, soft bokeh lights, white floral hedges, a dark starry night sky, and dramatic luxury-event lighting. The three subjects should have smooth anonymized/blurred faces with no visible facial features, but highly detailed hair, jewelry, bodies, and gowns. Left subject: petite figure leaning slightly left, dark black hair in a polished low bun, wearing a strapless silver crystal corset bodice with a deep navy satin mermaid skirt, ornate gold-and-silver embroidery down the side, draped navy fabric at the hip, dangling tassel ornament, choker necklace, bracelets, and a small train. Center subject: tallest figure standing confidently with one hand on her hip, lavender-purple hair styled in a large sculptural braided updo, wearing a strapless silver beaded corset gown with a deep navy velvet diagonal sash over one shoulder, silver satin draped skirt, high thigh slit, dark navy embroidered side panel, long flowing silver train, sparkling brooch at the shoulder, layered necklace, rings, and strappy high heels. Right subject: poised figure with very long straight rose-pink hair in a high ponytail flowing to the right, wearing a black velvet strapless couture gown with dense silver pearl-and-crystal chains, black opera gloves, ornate choker, fitted bodice, large dark navy rose-shaped fabric sculpture at the hip, long black and navy velvet train, and one hand on her hip. Use a rich palette of {argument name="main dress colors" default="midnight navy, silver, black velvet, and rose pink"}, elaborate couture beadwork, pearl draping, embroidered floral appliqués, glossy satin, velvet textures, and dramatic Met Gala styling. Composition should be full-body, vertical 2:3 aspect ratio, three figures centered and filling the frame, photographed from a slightly low angle to emphasize grandeur. Make the image look like a real luxury fashion photo rather than a cartoon, while keeping subtle anime-character-inspired silhouettes and hair colors. Avoid logos, readable text, watermarks, extra people in the foreground, distorted hands, or additional main subjects.

Goal: Create a fictional Japanese movie information page and poster for an anime sci-fi mystery film titled {argument name="movie title" default="ノヴァ・リフレイン"}, with the subtitle {argument name="subtitle" default="終わらない記憶"}. The design should look like a polished streaming/movie review website screenshot paired with theatrical key art.

Canvas: Vertical 3:4 composition, dark navy interface, approximately 768×1024. Use a two-column top layout and a full-width review feed below. Overall mood is futuristic, rainy, emotional, and cinematic.

Top-left poster: A tall theatrical anime poster with rounded corners and a thin blue border. Show a rainy cyberpunk city at night under a starry purple-blue galaxy sky. In the foreground is a teenage anime girl wearing a black hooded jacket, glowing cyan cat-ear headphones, dark twin-tail hair, and a small sleeve patch reading “S-07”. Her face is deliberately obscured by a soft square gray blur censor block. A small distant figure stands in the wet street behind her. Add Japanese tagline text at upper left: “記憶は、消えても、想いは、残る。” At the bottom of the poster, display the large title “ノヴァ・リフレイン”, beneath it “— NOVA: REFRAIN —”, then “— 終わらない記憶 —”, and at the very bottom “2025.07.18 (FRI) ROADSHOW” in purple-blue lettering.

Top-right movie details panel: Use a dark card with subtle borders and clean Japanese UI typography. Include exactly 4 genre tags at the top: “SF”, “ヒューマンドラマ”, “青春”, “ミステリー”. Below them show the title “ノヴァ・リフレイン” and subtitle “— 終わらない記憶 —”. Add the release line “2025年7月18日公開 / 上映時間 126分”. Show overall rating with exactly 5 gold star icons, the last star half-filled, and numeric rating “4.4”. Include exactly 3 action buttons: a purple play button labeled “予告編を見る”, an outlined bookmark button labeled “あとで観る”, and an outlined share button labeled “シェア”.

Synopsis section: Add heading “あらすじ” and a short Japanese synopsis about a near-future world where memory data has become normal, a high school girl named レティシア tries to restore the lost memories of a friend after an accident, and discovers a hidden “truth” that could alter the fate of the world.

Staff and cast section: Use two columns. Staff column title “スタッフ” with exactly 8 fictional staff lines: “監督：ソフト・レイン”, “脚本：ミサセ・ユウリ”, “音楽：ハルカ・ミサキ”, “撮影：フジサキ・レン”, “美術：カガリ・トウマ”, “編集：ナギサ・コトネ”, “VFX：アイオ・シュウ”, “制作：エクリプス・ピクチャーズ”. Cast column title “キャスト” with exactly 6 fictional cast lines: “レティシア：ユイナ・カナメ”, “アイオ：カガミ・リク”, “カイト：ハヤセ・ソウタ”, “博士：レイジ・クロサワ”, “ナビAI「ノヴァ」：ミユ・シラカワ”, plus one additional short fictional name if needed to fill spacing. Do not use real celebrity names.

Review feed: Below the top panels, create a section titled “みんなのレビュー” with a small button on the right reading “すべてのレビューを見る”. Include exactly 5 review cards stacked vertically, each with a circular avatar, reviewer display name, handle, gold star rating, bold Japanese review title/body, timestamp, and purple thumbs-up count. Reviews are:
1. Avatar: anime girl portrait. Name “星乃そら”, handle “@sora_hoshino_23”, rating “5.0” with 5 gold stars, title “今年一番の没入感。ラスト10分、涙が止まらなかった。” timestamp “2025/7/18 23:41”, likes “324”.
2. Avatar: dark-haired anime boy side profile. Name “霧島レン”, handle “@lenscape_07”, rating “4.5”, title “SF好きなら絶対ハマる。設定も演出も一級品。” timestamp “2025/7/19 10:12”, likes “198”.
3. Avatar: cute cat photo. Name “もちまる”, handle “@mochimaru_33”, rating “3.5”, title “泣けるけど、ちょっと難しかったかも？” timestamp “2025/7/19 14:56”, likes “87”.
4. Avatar: blue sky and clouds photo. Name “蒼井ナツメ”, handle “@natsume_aoi”, rating “4.0”, title “音楽がとにかく良い。サントラ絶対買う。” timestamp “2025/7/19 18:30”, likes “142”.
5. Avatar: anime portrait with face softly blurred. Name “タカト・ユウキ”, handle “@yuki_t_movie”, rating “2.5”, title “設定は面白いけど、後半の展開が駆け足すぎたかな。” timestamp “2025/7/20 00:05”, likes “51”.

Visual style: High-quality anime key visual combined with a modern dark-mode Japanese cinema database UI. Use neon cyan and purple accents, soft glow, rainy reflections, thin dividers, rounded cards, crisp legible Japanese text, gold stars, and a premium sci-fi drama atmosphere. Keep all names fictional and avoid real staff or cast.

Create a vertical 9:16 anime-style illustration set inside a dim industrial emergency stairwell at night. The camera is a high-angle first-person point of view looking down at a teenage girl standing on a metal diamond-plate stair landing, reaching toward the viewer and holding the viewer's hand in the foreground. She wears a short-sleeved white button-up school blouse with a collar, a dark olive-black layered ruffle skirt, and a loose blue-gray ribbon tied at the waist. Her {argument name="hair color" default="olive brown with blonde highlights and green-purple dyed streaks"} hair is shoulder length with bangs and side locks, slightly messy, catching cool overhead light. Add a large opaque square censor block over the center of her face, filled with a soft muted brown-to-pink gradient, hiding all facial features. The setting includes exactly 4 major stairwell elements: gray concrete walls, silver metal safety railings, textured steel floor panels, and one glowing emergency wall lamp near the lower left casting warm yellow light. Use dramatic cinematic anime lighting with cool blue-gray shadows, warm lamp glow, detailed line art, subtle film-grain texture, and a slightly intimate emotional mood as if she is guiding the viewer up or down the emergency stairs. Keep the composition tight, with her torso and skirt dominant in frame, one of her hands extended toward the viewer, the viewer's hand visible at bottom center, and no text or watermark.

Goal: Create a polished anime storyboard sheet for a fictional 10-second trading card battle anime sequence, designed like a cinematic ad storyboard made from five horizontal panels.

Canvas: Landscape 16:10 white storyboard page with thin gray table borders, a centered Japanese headline at the top reading {argument name="headline text" default="10秒トレーディングカードバトルアニメ 絵コンテ"}, a thin red line accent near the top left, and a small angular red logo-like mark in the top right.

Layout: Use a three-column storyboard grid. The left column is narrow and contains red cut labels plus timing. The center column is wide and contains cinematic anime stills. The right column is a white notes column with camera direction and action notes. There are exactly 5 horizontal rows, separated by light gray lines.

Visible cut list: 1) Cut 1, 0.0s-2.0s: wide establishing arena shot. 2) Cut 2, 2.0s-4.0s: medium-close shot of the protagonist activating a card device. 3) Cut 3, 4.0s-6.2s: extreme close-up of a card thrust toward the viewer. 4) Cut 4, 6.2s-8.5s: whip-pan summoning scene with a dragon hologram appearing. 5) Cut 5, 8.5s-10.0s: final low-angle hero-and-dragon shot.

Subject details: The protagonist is {argument name="protagonist description" default="a fiery red-haired teenage anime boy wearing a red-and-black battle jacket, fingerless gloves, and a glowing mechanical card duel device on one arm"}. The summoned monster is {argument name="dragon description" default="a crimson armored dragon with huge wings, jagged horns, glowing red crystal chest core, and ember-like highlights"}. The arena is {argument name="arena description" default="a futuristic packed stadium at night with blue neon spotlights, a glowing duel field, massive audience stands, and a giant VS screen"}. The main card art shows a red demonic dragon emblem and fiery energy.

Center-panel imagery: Cut 1 shows the full stadium duel field with the red-haired protagonist on the left, an opponent in white far away on the right, giant red and blue card banners, and a large glowing “VS” display in the background. Cut 2 shows the protagonist grinning confidently, holding up a red dragon card while red energy coils around the wrist-mounted duel device; intentionally obscure or soften the exact face area as if motion-blurred/censored. Cut 3 shows a sharp close-up of one intense red eye and the raised dragon card, with rack-focus depth of field and explosive red particle streaks behind it. Cut 4 shows a red magic circle covering the arena floor as the dragon materializes in holographic flame beside the protagonist. Cut 5 shows the protagonist standing heroically beside the fully formed dragon, both lit from below by red embers and dramatic battle light.

Right-column text notes: For Cut 1 write “wide shot / dolly in / audience cheers, introduce protagonist”. For Cut 2 include the red Japanese quote {argument name="summon quote" default="「来い、紅蓮王ドラグレイザー！」"} followed by “medium-close-up / fearless smile / device activation”. For Cut 3 write “extreme close-up / rack focus / thrust card toward camera”. For Cut 4 write “whip pan / hologram summon / dragon appears”. For Cut 5 write “low angle / orbit shot / decisive cut”.

Visual style: High-energy modern shonen anime, glossy digital painting, cinematic lighting, red and blue color contrast, intense lens flares, speed lines, sparks, holographic particles, dramatic perspective, crisp storyboard presentation, professional production-board clarity.

Constraints: Keep exactly 5 storyboard rows, exactly 3 columns, and preserve the timing labels. Do not add extra cuts, extra characters, watermarks, or unrelated UI elements.

Goal: Create a vertical Japanese 4-panel manga comic about a cute chibi girl becoming even more excited when a rainy sports day is postponed.

Canvas: Tall vertical comic page in full color, approximately 9:16, with a white outer margin and thick black panel borders. Use exactly 4 stacked horizontal panels of equal width, manga-style composition, energetic expressions, glossy digital coloring, bold outlines, dramatic speed lines, sparkles, and sound effects.

Main character: A single chibi elementary-school girl named {argument name="character name" default="purple-haired girl"}. She has long wavy lavender-purple hair, pale skin, round gray eyes that turn into sparkling star eyes when excited, rosy cheeks, and a small open mouth. She wears a pale pink short-sleeve blouse with buttons, a light beige skirt, white socks, and simple shoes. Her pose is usually fists clenched near her chest in excitement or surprise.

Panel 1: School sports day setup under stormy clouds. Show the girl standing large in the center of a school athletic field, smiling with clenched fists and sparkles around her. Background includes a school building, Japanese flag, strings of international flags, a clock, a flower-decorated sports day arch labeled 「運動会」, tents, cones, bags, and lunch boxes. Add a large vertical speech bubble on the right with 「今日は運動会！」. At the very top outside or above the first panel, add the headline: {argument name="headline text" default="雨が空ごとプールに変わっても、楽しみは10倍に跳ね上がる！"}.

Panel 2: Indoor announcement scene. Show a wall-mounted gray loudspeaker on the left, a taped white notice below it reading 「雨で延期」, and the girl on the right in close-up looking shocked with a sweat drop, clenched fist, and wide open mouth. Add a speech bubble on the right reading 「延期!?」. Use beige indoor wall tones and manga burst lines radiating from her face.

Panel 3: Torrential rain on the sports field. Show the athletic field transformed into a shallow flooded pool under heavy rain, lightning, dark storm clouds, and dramatic water splashes. The girl stands in the foreground with star-shaped eyes and an amazed open mouth, holding a spiral-bound calendar that reads 「運動会（新しい日）」 with a large red circled 「7」 and 「日後！」 underneath. Add two sound effects: blue 「ザーッ」 for heavy rain on the left and orange 「ゴロゴロ」 for thunder on the upper right. Add a vertical speech bubble on the right reading 「あと7日!?」.

Panel 4: Extreme close-up celebration. Fill the panel with the girl's happy face, sparkling star eyes, open smiling mouth, and clenched fists. Use a hot pink and red radial burst background filled with yellow sparkles. Add one jagged speech bubble on the left containing 「100倍!!」 in red and 「楽しみ」 in black, meaning the excitement is multiplied.

Text count and placement: Include exactly 1 headline, exactly 4 comic panels, exactly 4 speech bubbles, exactly 1 taped notice, exactly 1 calendar page, exactly 2 manga sound effects, and exactly 1 sports day arch label. Preserve all Japanese text exactly as written. Avoid adding extra dialogue, captions, logos, watermarks, or additional characters.

Visual style: Cute Japanese chibi manga, bright saturated colors, clean black line art, expressive faces, playful dramatic exaggeration, polished webcomic look, high readability of all Japanese text.

Goal: Create a cute LINE sticker sheet featuring {argument name="character name" default="a white-haired cat-eared anime girl and a small blue penguin mascot"} in a soft chibi style, with exactly 9 separate sticker illustrations arranged in a 3 by 3 grid on a clean white background.

Canvas: Square 1:1 image, high resolution, lots of white space between stickers, each sticker isolated with no panel borders. Use pastel colors, thick clean outlines, gentle shading, expressive poses, and playful handwritten Japanese sticker text above or near each pose.

Character details: The main girl is a chibi anime cat girl with long fluffy white hair with pale pink tips, white cat ears, blue eyes, a small tail, a blue oversized hoodie, yellow leg warmers, white shoes, and cute hair clips. The mascot is a round navy-blue penguin wearing a matching blue hoodie with a tiny pouch label, orange beak and feet, and simple cheerful expressions.
